correctness.rationale: Exact tangent-cone partition and Gaussian radial invariance yield the Dirichlet formula. Factorial moment identities, an explicit fourth-moment bound and Taylor estimates prove the \(7/(2d)\) coefficient with \(O(d^{-3/2})\) remainder. Weighted Dirichlet total-variation convergence to unweighted Dirichlet and exponential representation prove the conditional independent-Laplace law. Both standalone verifier programs executed successfully; experiments are corroboration only.
